extracted.intended_audience: defense acquisition officials, government procurement analysts, naval personnel researchers, and policymakers
extracted.subtask_description: A cost-comparison study, performed in accordance with OMB Circular No. A-76, evaluating whether an in-house Human Resource Management Information Network (HRMIN) or a contract-out alternative is the most cost-effective means of providing required services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Circular No. A-76
rubrics_metrics.description: Ascertain the compliance of this in-house development with the Office of Management and Budget policy on the acquisition of commercial or industrial products and services needed by the government (OMB Circular No. A-76).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The thesis examines whether the in-house HRMIN development conforms to OMB A-76 acquisition policy; compliance is evaluated as part of deciding whether contracting out is appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost comparison: in-house performance cost vs contract-out cost
rubrics_metrics.description: A cost comparison of the in-house performance cost and the contract-out cost of providing the services required of HRMIN.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Directly compare measured/estimated costs for in-house delivery against contract proposals or estimates to determine which alternative is less costly; this comparison is the primary analytic mechanism used to reach a recommendation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost-effectiveness of alternatives
rubrics_metrics.description: Determine which alternative (present in-house performance or conversion to contracted-out performance) is the most cost effective.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The study's outcome is based on which alternative yields the greatest cost-effectiveness; in this case the finding was that 'the present in-house performance is the most cost effective alternative' and thus conversion should not be undertaken.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost-benefit analysis (additional keyword/consideration)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use cost-benefit analysis techniques to assess the financial and possibly nonfinancial consequences of in-house versus contract-out options.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although not elaborated on this page, 'Cost benefit analysis' is listed as an additional keyword, implying that benefits as well as costs should be considered when evaluating alternatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of services required (service requirements coverage)
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluate the services required of HRMIN to ensure that the cost comparison covers the full set of functions and obligations the system must provide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The cost comparison should be scoped to the services required of HRMIN so that both in-house and contract-out cost estimates reflect equivalent service levels and obligations.
